Globex International Mobility Policy v2.1
Effective 2026-02-01

Section A — Housing

Globex supports housing during the relocation period. The cap depends on destination:

  - Oslo: NOK 30,000 per month
  - London: GBP 4,500 per month
  - New York: USD 6,000 per month
  - Singapore: SGD 7,000 per month

Temporary accommodation is provided for the first 90 days.

Section B — Movers

Household goods shipment is supported. The exact cubic footage will be agreed at assignment start.

Section C — Schools

Education support for dependent children, amounts to be discussed case by case.
